summary: An Undo history over a set of nodes and fields: look (a preset's parts), view and lighting, a V's creator choices, or its clothing.

fields.doc: Member node → the fields it covers (absent: all).

steps.doc: Step IDs, oldest first; each names the commits it made and its label.

redo.doc: Steps undone and still redoable; cleared by any other commit in the scope.

depth.doc: How many steps are kept (80 for looks).

kept.doc: How many of the latest steps survive a reload (look history today).

migration.how: The kept steps are replayed as the look scope's first steps for the migrated preset; View and lighting and character history start empty, as they are session-only today.

x-friction.gap: Look history spans a preset's parts, keeps 80 steps chunked, allows Redo only while the look is exactly what the last Undo left, and jumps to any step; the engine's undo is per commit.
x-friction.closes: Undo over named sets of nodes and fields, steps of several commits, redo cleared by other commits in the set, bounded depth by compaction, and jumps.

x-friction.gap: A few steps of a session history are kept across a reload, the rest dropped.
x-friction.closes: Selective recording of a session stream: keep the last N steps.
